ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Rundll32 Invoking Inline VBScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious process related to rundll32 based on command line that invokes inline VBScript as seen being used by UNC2452

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Execute.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*RegRead.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*window\\\.close.*"))
